description: Move the trader's rule through the studio's state machine when forge is refused: score_parts (Jev scores clarity — needs the trader's own TypeSafe key), accept_parts (the trader accepts the rule as read, without a Jev score), choose_coverage with choice approximate (build from the gates the tape can measure) or stop, reset (start over). Ask the trader before accepting or choosing for them; the studio decides every gate, this only performs the move they chose.
name: studio_move
